DEFINE INSTRUMENT TAS_instrument(
  KF = 5,
  KI = 0,
  QM = 1,
  EN = 0,
  verbose = 1,
  WM = 0.233,
  HM = 0.197,
  RMH = -1,
  RMV = -1,
  DM = 1.807,
  NHM = 15,
  NVM = 15,
  WA = 0.16,
  HA = 0.08,
  RAH = -1,
  RAV = -1,
  DA = 2.087,
  NHA = 15,
  NVA = 15,
  L1 = 2.3,
  ALF1 = 60,
  ALF2 = 60,
  ALF3 = 60,
  ALF4 = 60,
  BET1 = 120,
  BET2 = 120,
  BET3 = 120,
  BET4 = 120,
  Sqw_coh = "V.lau"
)

DECLARE
%{
  double machine_hkl_l1 = L1;
  double machine_real_a1 = 0; // Not given, assuming 0
  double machine_hkl_ei = 81.81 / (KF * KF); // Assuming KF is k_final and using E = 81.81 / lambda^2
%}

COMPONENT Origin = Progress_bar() AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Source = Source_gen(
  radius = 0.10,
  dist = machine_hkl_l1,
  focus_xw = fabs(WM * sin(machine_real_a1 * DEG2RAD)),
  focus_yh = HM,
  E0 = machine_hkl_ei,
  dE = machine_hkl_ei * 0.03,
  I1 = 0.5874e+13,
  T1 = 683.7,
  T2 = 257.7,
  I2 = 2.5099e+13,
  T3 = 16.7,
  I3 = 1.0343e+12
) AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Monitor1 = Monitor_nD(
  xwidth = 0.3,
  yheight = 0.3,
  filename = "Monitor1.dat",
  restore_neutron = 1
) AT (0, 0, machine_hkl_l1 / 4) RELATIVE Source

COMPONENT SC1 = Collimator_linear(
  xmin = -WM / 2,
  xmax = WM / 2,
  ymin = -HM / 2,
  ymax = HM / 2,
  length = machine_hkl_l1 / 2,
  divergence = ALF1,
  divergenceV = BET1
) AT (0, 0, machine_hkl_l1 / 4) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE WHEN (ALF1 && BET1)

COMPONENT Guide_out = Arm() AT (0, 0, machine_hkl_l1 - 0.2) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Monitor_PSD = Monitor_nD(
  xwidth = 0.1,
  yheight = 0.1,
  filename = "PSD_monitor.dat",
  restore_neutron = 1
) AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE Guide_out

COMPONENT Monitor_wavelength = Monitor_Lambda(
  xmin = -0.05,
  xmax = 0.05,
  ymin = -0.05,
  ymax = 0.05,
  Lmin = 0,
  Lmax = 10,
  nL = 100,
  filename = "wavelength_monitor.dat",
  restore_neutron = 1
) AT (0, 0, 0.1) RELATIVE Guide_out

END
```
